subject: Commercial parameters & next steps — MedPath inference pilot
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 22:10:00 +0000
Subject: Commercial parameters & next steps — MedPath inference pilot

Hi Lena,

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate the clarity on your use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move to a scoped pilot:

Summary of expected usage (from our conversation)
- Primary flow: clinical triage assistant (symptom intake + note summarization)
- Expected MAU: 45k active users/month
- Expected peak daily concurrency: ~1800 reqs/day; typical session = 350 tokens in + 150 tokens out on average
- Projected monthly token volume: ~1.8M - 2.5M tokens/day => ~55M - 75M tokens/month (rough range)

Pricing & unit-econ targets you mentioned
- Target budget band (internal): $35k - $70k / month
- Targeted $ / 1M tokens (price-to-budget): you'd like to see scenarios at $200 - $800 / 1M tokens depending on commitment and feature mix
- CAC payback target: 6-9 months for the initial feature rollout
- Margin target vs inference costs: net gross margin >= 60% after inference spend on the feature

Open items we need from MedPath
1) Per-feature priority list (which features to instrument first: triage, summary, suggested diagnosis) — so we can map token-per-feature.
2) Rough forecast of DAU -> sessions/day mapping (sample week or pivot table)
3) Procurement/contact for SOW and security paperwork (if legal needs to loop in)

Next steps I propose
- We'll produce per-feature token-attribution estimates + three pricing scenarios (hosted pay-as-you-go, 3-month pilot committed, 12-month reserved)
- Internal: Marissa will draft a unit-econ worksheet tying projected revenue and CAC to tokens/feature.
- Schedule: follow-up working session (45 min) next week — I can do Tue/Wed morning PST.

I attached a short template we'll fill (MP-Monthly-usage-estimates.xlsx) and a summary of our pricing scenarios.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0173
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medpath.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@medpath.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 23:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commercial parameters & next steps — MedPath inference pilot

Thanks Jonas — this is helpful.

Couple clarifications:
- MAU: 45k is our optimistic target; conservative plan is 28k MAU in Q3.
- Token profile: clinical notes tend to be longer; while the intake is 350/150 you quoted, summaries skew to 800+ output tokens when a clinician opens the note. Could push monthly volumes towards upper range if we instrument summaries.
- Budget: the $35k-$70k band is what our PM signaled; procurement can stretch to $85k/mo for the right SLAs + privacy controls.

Can you include a breakout for (a) hosted (shared) vs (b) dedicated reserved capacity (per month) and the impact on $/1M tokens? Also want a line for one-off integration/setup cost (SAML, data connectors) — get me a ballpark.

Procurement timeline: aim to finalize terms by 2027-07-21. Please put Evan on the loop for procurement and security paperwork.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, MedPath Health
lena.ortiz@medpath.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medpath.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Commercial parameters & next steps — MedPath inference pilot

Hi Lena — looping in some initial numbers and attachments.

Attached: MP-Monthly-usage-estimates.xlsx; redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf; feature-token-map.csv

High-level unit-econ sketches (ballpark, subject to benchmark results):
- Hosted (shared, no commit): $900 - $1,400 / 1M tokens (includes burst pricing + multi-tenant infra)
- Pilot committed (3-month, reserved): $450 - $750 / 1M tokens (20-40% discount vs shared)
- Dedicated reserved (12-month, isolated pool): $180 - $420 / 1M tokens (depends on pool size, quantization, and batching)

Feature-level example (using your feature set; per 1k sessions/month):
- Intake form (avg 500 tokens/session): ~0.5M tokens/month -> cost buckets: $90 - $700
- Summarization (avg 1200 tokens/session): ~1.2M tokens/month -> cost buckets: $220 - $1,680
- Clinician assist (conversational follow-up avg 400 tokens/session): ~0.4M tokens/month -> cost buckets: $70 - $560

Workplan / next steps
- We will run a 48-hour benchmark on a 5k-session sample you can share (token-attribution + latency profile).
- Pricing worksheet: fill in your MAU conservative and optimistic columns and we'll convert into M tokens and attach recommended bands.
- Legal/procurement: Jonas will introduce our procurement lead and share a SOW template; we can draft initial commitment language for the 3-month pilot.

Proposed meeting: Tue, 2027-06-29 16:00 ET / 13:00 PT — confirm if that works; otherwise propose Wed morning.

Thanks — happy to adjust these figures after benchmarking. 

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: MP-Monthly-usage-estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-pricing-scenarios.pdf (pdf), feature-token-map.csv (csv)

Quick internal:
- I'll add our finance lead (cc'ing separately) to model CAC payback scenarios at 6 vs 9 vs 12 months using Marissa's banded costs.
- Suggest we prepare two decks: (1) feature-level P&L (per 1k sessions) showing margin impact; (2) procurement timeline + SOW ask list.
- Jonas — can you confirm whether MedPath needs HSM/KMS integration or just standard KMS? Lena, flag if you prefer HSM — that'll change setup cost materially.

Karthik
